description: Learned PAD failure modes: load failure, inference failure, model uncertainty (FailClosed), and privacy boundary enforcement. All model failures map to Unavailable, never silent analytic-only fallback.

gates.description: FinalVerdict::FailClosed (model uncertain/unavailable) → Verdict::Unavailable, NOT silent analytic-only fallback
Backend infer() returning Err → Verdict::Unavailable (learned pad failed), not NoMatch and not silent fallback
OnnxCpuLearnedPad::load with missing model returns Err → daemon cannot construct the backend → daemon must not start
OnnxCpuLearnedPad load with nonexistent path returns error, never panics
MockLearnedPadBackend load with nonexistent path returns NotFound, never panics
Empty differential input → LearnedPadError::Shape, not panic, not Uncertain
OnnxCpuLearnedPad infer with empty differential → Shape error (returns before session use)
Analytic live + learned uncertain → FailClosed (fail-closed refuse, mapped to Unavailable)
PadResult::unavailable() is Uncertain and refuses (fail-closed sentinel)
VetoPolicy::validate rejects live_min <= spoof_max (misconfiguration caught at construction)
Learned PAD veto reasons carry no biometric data: no gate names, scores, embeddings, thresholds, or probabilities in external reasons
External reason for learned PAD Unavailable is generic — does not leak PAD internals to the PAM client
All PAD veto variants (energy, gradient, specular, radial, learned, analytic) are stripped to None at the trust boundary
VetoPolicy introduces no GPU-related configuration; the CPU-only provider is enforced by OnnxCpuLearnedPad's session builder
